en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a large historic building, likely a train station, surrounded by trees and greenery. The front side of the card has printed text identifying the location as 'Sundsvall' and 'Jernvägsstationen' (Swedish for 'railway station'). There is handwritten text in Swedish on the image. The reverse side is formatted for an address, written in cursive script with a green Swedish stamp (Oscar II, 5 öre) and a postmark. The text is primarily in Swedish.
